content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-429. - I.P.C. Section 912.1, Horizontal wet vent permitted.
content.summary:
Section 912.1. Horizontal wet vent permitted,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
912.1. Horizontal wet vent permitted.
Horizontal wet vents shall be located and installed in conformance with the requirements
                  of the Colorado Plumbing Code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11…
